title: 9-Year-Old Tala Abu Matar Killed by Israeli Fire Near Nuseirat
detail: Tala Juma Abu Matar, a 9-year-old girl, was killed by Israeli fire that struck a displacement camp near the Ain Jalut towers in the Tabbet al-Nuwairi area, between the Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camps in central Gaza. Mahmoud Mohammad Tawfiq Muslih also died from wounds sustained two days earlier. At least 5 people were killed in fresh strikes across Gaza that day. The Gaza Health Ministry said the cumulative death toll since October 7, 2023 had risen to 73,221, with 173,643 wounded.

title: Five-Day Settler Siege of Al-Jabour Family Ends With Elderly Man Detained, 7 Relatives Injured
detail: For five consecutive days, Israeli settlers attacked the family of elderly Ibrahim Ismail al-Jabour in the Huwara area of Masafer Yatta, in the South Hebron Hills. Israeli soldiers who arrived at the scene protected the attacking settlers rather than the family, and by July 12 had detained al-Jabour himself, while seven of his relatives — including two children — were injured by settlers. No settler was arrested. OCHA has recorded more than 1,200 settler incidents causing casualties or property damage across the West Bank in 2026, roughly six a day.
